findings.title: Anonymous FTP login is allowed
findings.evidence: The ftp-anon script reports anonymous FTP login allowed on port 21/tcp.
findings.remediation: Disable anonymous FTP unless it is explicitly required, and restrict access to trusted networks.

findings.title: Multiple web services are reachable
findings.remediation: Review whether each web service must be reachable and place administrative services behind access controls.

findings.title: SSH is exposed
findings.evidence: Port 22/tcp is open and identified as OpenSSH 9.6p1 Ubuntu.
findings.remediation: Require key-based authentication, disable password login where possible, and limit SSH access to trusted sources.

ai_summary.executive: The scan found one Linux host with FTP, SSH, Apache, Jetty, a proxy-like service, and a web dashboard exposed. Anonymous FTP access is the top issue, followed by the number of reachable web and administrative services.
